definition: To provide people to operate a place or a machine.
example: Volunteers manned the phones all night.
exampleTr: Gönüllüler bütün gece telefonların başında durdu.

definition: To provide a place for people or things to stay.
example: The old barn houses the museum collection.

definition: Difficult and demanding patience.
example: It has been a trying week for the family.
exampleTr: Aile için yıpratıcı bir hafta oldu.

definition: To make something as good as it can possibly be.
example: She spent years perfecting the recipe.

definition: The drawer in a shop where money is kept.
example: The manager counted the till at closing.

definition: To express an opinion or a feeling in words.
example: Several members voiced serious concerns.
exampleTr: Birkaç üye ciddi endişelerini dile getirdi.

definition: To place someone or something in a category.
example: The species is classed as endangered.

definition: To stop a plane from flying, or to base an argument on evidence.
example: Fog grounded every flight that morning.
exampleTr: Sis o sabah bütün uçuşları durdurdu.

definition: A piece of cloth hung on a wall as decoration.
example: A woven hanging covered the stone wall.
exampleTr: Dokuma bir duvar halısı taş duvarı örtüyordu.

definition: To train someone to behave in a particular way.
example: Years of noise had conditioned him to sleep through anything.
exampleTr: Yılların gürültüsü onu her şeye rağmen uyumaya şartlandırmıştı.

definition: To make a movement or a sound that gives information.
example: The driver signalled before turning left.
exampleTr: Sürücü sola dönmeden önce işaret verdi.

definition: To become smaller, or to agree formally to do work.
example: Metal contracts as it cools.

definition: To become more solid or more certain.
example: The jelly firms up in the fridge.

definition: To abandon a person or a duty, especially in the army.
example: Two soldiers deserted before the battle.
exampleTr: İki asker savaştan önce firar etti.

definition: Something valuable that you give up for a greater purpose.
example: Her parents made real sacrifices for her education.
exampleTr: Ailesi eğitimi için gerçek fedakârlıklar yaptı.

definition: To give up something important for a better purpose.
example: He sacrificed his weekends to finish the book.
exampleTr: Kitabı bitirmek için hafta sonlarını feda etti.

definition: To work in an organized way towards a political aim.
example: They campaigned for cleaner water for a decade.
exampleTr: On yıl boyunca daha temiz su için kampanya yürüttüler.

definition: To keep a supply of goods for sale.
example: The shop stocks every size.

definition: To make muscles firmer through exercise.
example: Swimming tones the whole body.

definition: An official request to return a faulty product, or the ability to remember.
example: The company issued a recall of two thousand cars.
exampleTr: Şirket iki bin araç için geri çağırma başlattı.

definition: The start of a new product, or the sending of a rocket.
example: The launch was delayed by bad weather.

definition: Distant from something in nature or in experience.
example: His theory is far removed from daily life.

definition: To argue formally that a decision is wrong.
example: The family contested the will in court.

definition: To make something cold without freezing it.
example: Chill the wine for an hour before serving.
exampleTr: Şarabı servis etmeden bir saat önce soğut.

definition: A feeling of cold, or a sudden feeling of fear.
example: There was a chill in the evening air.

definition: To adjust an instrument or an engine so it works correctly.
example: The mechanic tuned the old engine.

definition: To try to win someone's support or affection.
example: The party wooed younger voters.
exampleTr: Parti genç seçmenlerin gönlünü kazanmaya çalıştı.

definition: To lose leaves, hair or skin naturally.
example: The trees shed their leaves early this year.
exampleTr: Ağaçlar bu yıl yapraklarını erken döktü.

definition: To turn something so it points in a particular direction.
example: She angled the lamp towards the page.

definition: A principle that is true in every situation.
example: In ethics there are few absolutes.

definition: To arrange something cleverly, often secretly.
example: He engineered the whole meeting.

definition: To make a hole with a tool, or to train by repetition.
example: They drilled through solid rock.

definition: A severe shock that has a lasting effect on the mind or the body.
example: The crash left lasting trauma.

definition: To give someone the information they need before a task.
example: The officer briefed the team at dawn.

definition: To formally ask someone to produce a piece of work.
example: The city commissioned a new statue.
exampleTr: Şehir yeni bir heykel siparişi verdi.

definition: Morally very bad, or playfully mischievous.
example: The story has a wicked stepmother.
exampleTr: Hikâyede kötü kalpli bir üvey anne var.

definition: A shirt worn by a sports team, or a knitted top.
example: He kept his old team jersey.

definition: Belonging to a breed of brown dairy cattle.
example: They keep a small jersey herd.

definition: A large family group with a shared ancestor.
example: The clan gathers every summer.

definition: To trick someone in order to take their money.
example: He conned the old man out of his savings.

definition: A trick to take money, or a disadvantage in an argument.
example: Weigh the pros and cons carefully.

definition: A sudden short period of activity or sound.
example: A burst of applause filled the hall.

definition: A reason for doing something, or the land around a building.
example: She was dismissed on grounds of dishonesty.

definition: To make someone feel less important or less proud.
example: The defeat humbled the champions.

definition: A live music performance, or a short piece of paid work.
example: The band played a small gig on Friday.
exampleTr: Grup cuma günü küçük bir konser verdi.

definition: A large water bird with a long neck.
example: A goose hissed at the dog.

definition: To start an official process or a system.
example: The government instituted new checks.

definition: To walk back and forth, or to control your speed.
example: He paced the corridor for an hour.

definition: The decision of a jury, or a judgement about something.
example: The jury reached a unanimous verdict.

definition: Too ready to believe things because of little experience.
example: It was naive to trust a stranger with the keys.
exampleTr: Anahtarları bir yabancıya emanet etmek safçaydı.

definition: To make someone confused because something is hard to explain.
example: The symptoms puzzled the doctors for weeks.

definition: To cause continuous trouble to someone.
example: Injuries plagued him all season.
exampleTr: Sakatlıklar bütün sezon başına bela oldu.

definition: To lose the hair on your head.
example: He began to bald in his thirties.

definition: To shelter someone secretly, or to keep a feeling in your mind.
example: She harboured doubts for years.

definition: To break into a computer system, or to cut roughly.
example: Someone hacked the company database.

definition: An act of breaking into a system, or a clever quick solution.
example: The hack exposed thousands of records.

definition: A doctor trained to treat mental illness.
example: Her psychiatrist changed the medication.

definition: Very strong desire, especially sexual or for power.
example: The play is about a lust for power.

definition: A person's sense of their own importance.
example: The criticism bruised his ego.

definition: To do something unpleasant because nothing else works.
example: They resorted to borrowing from relatives.

definition: Violent and cruel.
example: It was a vicious attack in broad daylight.

definition: A large military unit, or a group with a shared job.
example: The medical corps arrived within hours.

definition: Of a bluish purple colour.
example: The sky turned violet at dusk.

definition: To gather a crop from the fields.
example: They harvest the olives in November.

definition: A long search for something important.
example: His quest for the truth lasted years.

definition: Something left behind by a person or an era.
example: The bridge is the legacy of that period.

definition: To leave a child without parents.
example: The war orphaned thousands of children.

definition: A description of how a situation might develop.
example: Plan for the worst scenario.
exampleTr: En kötü senaryoya göre plan yap.

definition: Far from other places, or happening only once.
example: The village is isolated in winter.

definition: To create a problem or a risk, or to hold a position for a photograph.
example: The old wiring poses a real danger.
exampleTr: Eski tesisat gerçek bir tehlike teşkil ediyor.

definition: Unfriendly and strongly opposed to someone.
example: The crowd turned hostile after the decision.
exampleTr: Karardan sonra kalabalık düşmanca bir hâl aldı.

definition: A person who does something for pleasure, not for money.
example: The photograph was taken by an amateur.

definition: Done for enjoyment rather than as a paid job.
example: He plays in an amateur orchestra.

definition: To recover strength, or to come together in support.
example: The team rallied in the second half.

definition: To produce flowers.
example: The almond trees bloom in February.

definition: To give money illegally to make someone act in your favour.
example: He was accused of bribing an official.

definition: Money given illegally to influence someone's decision.
example: The clerk refused the bribe.

definition: To make an official complaint, or to become stuck somewhere.
example: She lodged a complaint with the council.

definition: To improve the appearance of land with plants and paths.
example: They landscaped the hospital garden.

definition: A quick rough drawing, or a short funny scene.
example: He made a sketch of the harbour in pencil.
exampleTr: Limanın kurşun kalemle bir eskizini yaptı.

definition: A device that makes a buzzing sound as a signal.
example: Press the buzzer to enter.

definition: Based on feelings rather than reason, sometimes too much so.
example: The watch has sentimental value only.
exampleTr: Saatin yalnızca duygusal bir değeri var.

definition: Being saved from danger or from sin.
example: The loan was the salvation of the company.

definition: For this reason, in formal English.
example: The bridge is unsafe; hence the closure.
exampleTr: Köprü güvenli değil; bu nedenle kapatıldı.

definition: To make something skilfully by hand.
example: He crafted the chair from a single log.
exampleTr: Sandalyeyi tek bir kütükten özenle yaptı.

definition: To record changes over time, often on a graph.
example: The study charts the fall in rainfall.

definition: Able to attract metal, or attracting people strongly.
example: She has a magnetic presence on stage.

definition: To hold a ship with an anchor, or to fix something firmly.
example: They anchored the boat in the bay.

definition: A member of a travelling people, an older and now often offensive word.
example: The song comes from a gypsy tradition.

definition: A common grey bird found in towns.
example: A pigeon landed on the statue.

definition: A court's decision that someone is guilty, or a strong belief.
example: He spoke with real conviction.

definition: To cover with frost, or to make glass cloudy.
example: The cold frosted every window.

definition: A person believed to bring messages from God.
example: The story concerns an ancient prophet.

definition: Weakened, or no longer safe or private.
example: The system was compromised overnight.
exampleTr: Sistemin güvenliği bir gecede ihlal edildi.

definition: Using science to investigate crime.
example: Forensic tests identified the material.

definition: Relating to the face.
example: The injury left no facial scar.

definition: A beauty treatment for the skin of the face.
example: She booked a facial for Friday.
exampleTr: Cuma için yüz bakımı randevusu aldı.

definition: Having no purpose or no importance.
example: Without context the figure is meaningless.

definition: To join two things into one, often by heating.
example: Heat fused the two metals.

definition: Money or property received from someone who has died.
example: She used the inheritance to open a shop.
exampleTr: Mirası bir dükkân açmak için kullandı.

definition: Stylish and of high quality.
example: It is a classy little restaurant.

definition: Determined to succeed without caring who is hurt.
example: He was ruthless in business.

definition: A person who gives religious talks.
example: The preacher spoke for an hour.

definition: To exchange one thing for another.
example: They swapped seats at the interval.

definition: An exchange of one thing for another.
example: We did a straight swap.

definition: The building and land used by a business.
example: Smoking is banned on these premises.

definition: To decide officially in court that someone is guilty.
example: The court convicted him of fraud.

definition: A person found guilty and sent to prison.
example: The convict was released early.

definition: To move away from the right place or subject.
example: The sheep strayed onto the road.

definition: Lost or with no home, said of an animal.
example: A stray cat sleeps by the door.
exampleTr: Kapının yanında bir sokak kedisi uyuyor.

definition: An animal that has no home.
example: The shelter takes in strays.

definition: Very great, or showing deep understanding.
example: The book had a profound effect on her.
exampleTr: Kitabın onun üzerinde derin bir etkisi oldu.

definition: A poor farmer who works a small piece of land.
example: The painting shows a peasant at work.

definition: A company that transports goods, or a person carrying a disease.
example: The carrier lost two parcels.

definition: A situation in which people are treated unfairly.
example: The film exposes a great injustice.
exampleTr: Film büyük bir adaletsizliği ortaya koyuyor.

definition: Having many carefully arranged parts.
example: The ceiling has an elaborate pattern.

definition: To explain something in more detail.
example: Could you elaborate on that point?

definition: The parts that make a machine work, or a way something happens.
example: The locking mechanism has jammed.

definition: To work less hard than you should.
example: Nobody slacked during the harvest.

definition: The loose part of a rope that is not pulled tight.
example: Take up the slack in the line.

definition: Loose, or with little business activity.
example: Trade is slack in January.

definition: Relating to the treatment of mental illness.
example: He works in a psychiatric hospital.

definition: The reporting of an event, or what an insurance policy includes.
example: The coverage of the election was thorough.

definition: Repeated behaviour that annoys or threatens someone.
example: The company has a harassment policy.

definition: The use of words to mean the opposite, or a strange contrast.
example: The irony was lost on him.

definition: Perfect happiness.
example: A quiet evening at home is bliss.
exampleTr: Evde sakin bir akşam tam bir mutluluk.

definition: The official power to make legal decisions in an area.
example: The case falls outside their jurisdiction.

definition: A person who makes and repairs wooden things.
example: The carpenter fitted new shelves.

definition: A young person who is not yet an adult in law.
example: The court treats juveniles differently.

definition: Relating to young people, or childish in behaviour.
example: His juvenile jokes annoyed everyone.

definition: A narrow band of leather or cloth used to fasten or carry.
example: The bag strap broke on the bus.

definition: To fasten something with a strap.
example: They strapped the load onto the roof.

definition: A temporary stop, or the springs supporting a vehicle.
example: He faces a two-match suspension.
exampleTr: İki maçlık bir cezayla karşı karşıya.

definition: Unable to feel anything, in body or in emotion.
example: My fingers were numb with cold.

definition: To make a part of the body unable to feel.
example: The dentist numbed her gum.

definition: The written script of a film.
example: She wrote the screenplay in six weeks.

definition: Cold enough to be uncomfortable, or unfriendly.
example: The mornings are chilly now.

definition: To make someone suffer, in body or in mind.
example: Guilt tormented him for years.
exampleTr: Suçluluk duygusu ona yıllarca eziyet etti.

definition: Great suffering of the body or the mind.
example: The wait was pure torment.

definition: To feel angry because you think you were treated unfairly.
example: She resented being left out.

definition: To move something quickly with a small sharp movement.
example: He flicked the switch and the lights came on.

definition: A person who makes clothes to fit one customer.
example: The tailor took his measurements.

definition: To make or change something to suit a particular need.
example: The course is tailored to beginners.

definition: Deep regret for something wrong you have done.
example: He showed no remorse in court.

definition: A precious stone, or something of great value.
example: The little museum is a real gem.

definition: Clear proof of something, or a will.
example: The bridge is a testament to their skill.

definition: Extremely large in size or degree.
example: The task required immense patience.

definition: To make someone angry, or to cause a reaction.
example: The remark provoked a long argument.
exampleTr: Bu söz uzun bir tartışmaya yol açtı.

definition: A woman who receives guests, or who serves on a plane.
example: Our hostess welcomed every guest by name.
exampleTr: Ev sahibemiz her konuğu adıyla karşıladı.

definition: A substance the body makes when you are excited or afraid.
example: Adrenaline kept him going.

definition: A person or company paid to do work for another.
example: The contractor finished ahead of time.

definition: Making you feel less tired, or pleasantly different.
example: It is refreshing to hear an honest answer.

definition: A bunch of flowers arranged and tied together.
example: She carried a small bouquet.

definition: To praise someone insincerely, or to make them look good.
example: That colour flatters her.

definition: A move downwards, or a person's family origin.
example: The descent took longer than the climb.

definition: To give a religious talk, or to tell others how to behave.
example: He preached to a full church.
